Dr. Rowe shows 4 methods to safely self pop, crack or release your wrist.

If it feels like your wrist is locked up and stiff, or it feels like it needs to be reset or popped, definitely check this video out.

Each method works differently. To get the best results, go through them all and use what gives you the most relief.

Watch now and self pop your wrist for instant relief!
